supports.question: Is the small gray rubber cylinder still identifiable as the same rubber cylinder?
supports.criteria: Pass if the image shows the target object retaining its identity as a rubber cylinder; fail if it is no longer identifiable as that object; unknown if the image does not provide enough evidence to assess identity.
supports.binding: Assess only the small gray rubber cylinder identified in the input image and instruction; unrelated objects do not count.

supports.question: Has the target cylinder’s visible color changed from gray to brown?
supports.criteria: Pass if the target cylinder is visibly brown; fail if it remains gray or is visibly a different non-brown color; unknown if its color cannot be determined from the image. A pass here alone does not establish complete fulfillment.
supports.binding: Assess the visible color of the same small gray rubber cylinder identified in the input image and instruction, not other image changes.
